facts.text: You eat like you are on a mission. Relax, nobody is stealing your noodles. Well, I might.
facts.why: Invented line signed Yelena Belova. It is not in Wikiquote or the plot, and no noodle scene exists. Her real line about plans is 'Okay, you got a plan, or shall I just stay, duck, and cover?'
facts.fix: Okay, you got a plan, or shall I just stay, duck, and cover?
